body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Samsung introduced 2008 design concept with its new LCD HDTV Series 7 during the press conference at CES 2008.

Nelson Allen, director of digital media of Samsung electronics, addressed that Samsung redefined the role HDTVs play in the home with its forward-looking LCD HDTV Series 7. Samsung’s TOC (Touch of Color) design features a hint of amber color naturally blended into Samsung’s traditional piano black bezel frame.

Samsung has also incorporated sophisticated networking and easy connection capability in response to consumer interest. In particular, up-to-the-minute access to weather, news, sports and stock information is just a cable and a click away through the HDTV’s Ethernet port and new InfoLink RSS service.
